name: navigation
description: Navigation flag from real kit event act-A0037 (training mission M004): a successful navigation step at WP06 that raised a HIGH LOCALIZATION_ISSUE beside the CRITICAL Heat Exchanger 17. Demonstrates meta.path first_pass. All numbers computed from amd/system1/data/kit with triage.policy 2026-10-10.1.

evidence.claim: SPOT logged a HIGH-severity LOCALIZATION_ISSUE at WP06 even though the navigation step itself succeeded.
The issue sits beside Heat Exchanger 17, a CRITICAL asset, which is what makes this P1.
WP06 has failed localization before: A0134 on the same heat exchanger in mission M014.

explanation.answer: Re-run SPOT's localization check at WP06 Compressor Area before trusting its position there. A HIGH localization issue beside the CRITICAL Heat Exchanger 17 means later inspections could be logged against the wrong place.
explanation.question: Is SPOT's position at WP06 reliable enough to keep inspecting Heat Exchanger 17?
